recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-15102; future work should treat the sibling identifier-cardinality issues as separate work-group decisions rather than broadening this Consent audit.
issue_request: FHIR-15102 is a Published/Persuasive CBCC change request for the Consent artifact. It asked that identifier elements whose business identifiers can occur multiple times, including Consent.identifier, change from 0..1 to 0..*.
initial_application: The old Consent spreadsheet shows Consent.identifier moving from 0..1 to 0..* in commit 61c95319e7, even though that commit message listed nearby GForge tickets rather than GF#15102. A follow-up Consent commit, 2c05932185, explicitly mentioned GF#15102 and preserved the 0..* cardinality while applying the same ballot batch with GF#15112.
additional_context: The current source is the post-spreadsheet StructureDefinition source, and source/fhir.ini actively includes consent=Consent. The same broad identifier-cardinality request was split across work groups: several sibling issues were Published for their own artifacts, while FHIR-15096, FHIR-15099, and FHIR-15103 record no-change or already-handled decisions for other artifacts. FHIR-15112 shares the historical Consent application commit and is already separately audited on the combined branch; it does not change the identifier conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were edited because source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml already defines Consent.identifier with min 0 and max * in active build scope.
